svg.text: Quiet, high-craft living that makes its own energy and water and closes the food + waste loop.
Primary house water; mains backup only
Drilled well + treatment, mains as backup only (P-103)
Home controller: solar-timed pool/irrigation, leak shut-off (E-103)
Passive cooling: deep eaves, courtyard cross-ventilation, ceiling fans, light roofs
ERV fresh air with enthalpy core
Healthy air at low cooling cost
Kitchen garden, raised beds, compost + 4-6 hens
EV-ready: 7.4 kW charger + spare conduit to carport
Low-carbon materials: AAC block, slag/fly-ash cement blend, plantation teak, charred timber (no paint), lime plaster
Car becomes a 60 kWh home battery
Solar-thermal / heat-pump pool heating on surplus
Green (sedum) roof on studio, + acoustic + cooling
Biogas digester for kitchen + coop waste
Included total about 3,847,000 THB · Optional add-ons about 910,000 THB (concept-level, 2026 prices, excl. VAT)
Sheet references: E-102 Solar, E-103 Controls, P-102 Rainwater + Kitchen Garden, P-103 Well + Treatment, M-101 HVAC. In the 3D viewer, the Solar, Water + Rainwater, Controls and Landscape + Farm
layers show each system in place.
Carbon figures use the Thai grid factor
